name: batch-geocode
title: Batch Geocode — Google / Mapbox / HERE → GeoJSON
description: Batch forward & reverse geocoding via the official Google Geocoding, Mapbox and HERE APIs (bring your own key). Lat/lng, formatted address, components, accuracy; GeoJSON + Markdown report; optional Distance Matrix. No Maps scraping. 256 MB. Not-found & failed rows free.
